data.title: Unit 6 : Environment
Caring for the environment
data.rubric: Click each image to know more about the four Rs.
data.text: The environment is the area around us.
The environment belongs to all living things.
Plant a tree to make a healthy environment.
Reduce, reuse, recycle, and repair are known as the four Rs to help you remember what should be done to keep the environment healthy.
Reduce the use of plastic bags.
Recycle plastic, paper, tin, and rubber.
Repair damaged things and use them again.
